summary.name: Dadabots
summary.one_liner: Dadabots is an AI music project that builds open-source neural nets for generating and performing live music, including death metal, harsh noise and experimental genres.
use_cases: generating experimental music with neural nets
exploring genre blending in music production
watching a documentary on AI DJing
building open-source music models with PyTorch
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Dadabots as a music project that builds open-source neural networks for music, with the tag 'diy neural nets open source live music'. It lists work with PyTorch and Ableton collaborations. It mentions a 'Genre Cannon' concept about cramming many genres into a few minutes of music. It references the AI Song Contest 2024 and a documentary called Prompt Jockeys, about DJing with AI where tracks are prompted live through a neural net. The page also lists performances, workshops, a keynote talk, a hackathon and an artist residency.
notable: Open-source neural nets for music, built with PyTorch
Prompt Jockeys documentary on live AI DJing
Genre Cannon project blending many genres
caveats: Page text is mostly a tag list and short project blurbs; few concrete product details are given
No pricing or downloadable tool is described on the page
